title: Solid Backend. Iffy iOS App
text:
While I have no issues with bitwarden as a platform, the iOS / Safari integration just leaves something to be desired.
It feels clunky at times and doesn’t always perform the right behavior. I’ve experienced random glitching, autofill failures, etc.

What if it was life or death situation?

title: Still Crashing
text:
What is wrong with you guys? Seriously. Your app crashes every browser except Safari when filling in 2FA codes. 1Password doesn’t have this issue, but I don’t want to switch to 1Password. I just want you to fix your app. You’d think this app would get better now that you’ve doubled the subscription price, but that 100% is not the case. It’s just gradually getting worse. Seriously. Please fix this. I was going to recommend this app to a friend, but I can’t until you fix this crashing nonsense.

Your app is the only password manager that crashes apps during 2FA. I’m honestly so close to switching to another password manager. Do you guys even care about your product anymore?

title: Stop With the “Rate Me” Nags
text:
When I’m trying to login smoothly and quickly to a website , the last thing i need is a pop up asking me to rate the app.  And I gave a paid subscription.  

But here goes - the interface is clunky, the app uses a lot of memory, it seems, abd half the time, it doesn’t suggest the password for the website, even though I have an entry that says to just match the base domain.  
A lot if tumes tge fields don’t get filled, but that could be the website itself’s fault.  

Oh, and the current ios version has the “install the Safari extension” link, but it points to the Mac version of the extension, and the Apple App Store app won’t let you install it.

title: Ok but could be better
text: I’m a transplant from Dashlane due to the ever increasing price. I’m currently trying Bitwarden as an alternative. Most of the app is showing it’s a good option. However a big negative keeping me from going with Bitwarden permanently, is if you change a password on one device it doesn’t automatically update on all other devices. You have to sign in, sign out, then sign in again to get it to update the password change. This is currently a point that’s keeping me from purchasing the app. If this issue was fixed I’d purchase now but I’m also trying a few other apps because of this issue.

title: CRASH-TASTIC! FAIL CREATING ACCOUNT FROM WITHIN OTHER APPS.
text:
5/30/26 UPDATE: Persistent bug where the app crashes when creating a login (vault item) from within an iOS app via Autofill>Passwords>+Login. 
First the app crashes while creating the new item. Then when you try again the iOS keyboard will not present, so you can’t proceed. 

Last several versions and this major bug persists despite release notes claim long press autofill bug is resolved. 

Otherwise generally good app. 

Also missing Credit Card + identity fill. 

The Bitwarden Mac desktop extension and competitors’ app have credit card and identity fill for forms and shopping. Even Apple’s lacking password service does. But confusingly Bitwarden has omitted this from their iOS app/extension. 

I can find no way for Bitwarden to fill Card details or name and address from Identity. Only items in the Login section can be filled. 

Big flaw as 1Password and others have had this for years. 

Sure you could use Apple's along side Bitwarden but then you have to maintain all your cards in 2 locations. Isn’t the point to have all of your stuff in ONE place?
